inventory_scope: External values crossing Claude Code, GitHub Actions, npm/Bun, Git, Sentry, extension-provider, and filesystem boundaries consumed by the pm CLI and SDK.

boundaries.format: absolute workspace path encoded as a dash-prefixed directory slug
redacted workflow-run JSON payload with check name, conclusion, and head SHA
native path and file URL package specifications including spaces and percent encoding
rev-parse commit output with one lowercase hexadecimal object id and trailing newline
redacted event JSON with issue id, timestamp, tags, and environment
argv forwarding and executable-path conventions across Bun releases
boundaries.waiver_reason: The matrix is exercised on hosted Bun runners; a single committed argv capture would falsely imply cross-version completeness. Re-verified 2026-11-12: the v2026.11.11 Release ran Bun registry acceptance and Prepublication Bun bootstrap on ubuntu, macOS and Windows, all green. Capture work is owned by pm-vodsfs.

boundaries.format: Win32 errno code, syscall, path, and message combinations
boundaries.waiver_reason: The existing windows-latest nightly is authoritative; private runner paths cannot be committed safely and need a redacted capture exporter first. Re-verified 2026-11-12: no exporter exists yet; it is shared with the pm-3lhth4 errno translation primitive and tracked by pm-vodsfs.

boundaries.format: Darwin errno code, syscall, path, and message combinations
boundaries.waiver_reason: The hosted macOS nightly is authoritative until the cross-platform redacted errno corpus exporter exists. Re-verified 2026-11-12: no exporter exists yet; it is shared with the pm-3lhth4 errno translation primitive and tracked by pm-vodsfs.

boundaries.format: provider-defined numeric or string-list measurement response
boundaries.waiver_reason: Providers are extension-owned and validated against their runtime contract; each provider package must own its captured service fixture. Re-verified 2026-11-12: no first-party package capture is committed yet; pm-vodsfs owns capturing one.
